description: This file declares exported API functions for the TLS Session Entry object, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization routines used within the TLS implementation component.

methods.name: TlsCreateSessionEntry
methods.description: Creates and returns a new TLS session entry object, given container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: TlsSeoCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new TLS Session Entry object with the provided context handles.

methods.name: TlsSeoRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the specified TLS Session Entry object.

methods.name: TlsSeoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls any necessary objects or dependencies for the TLS Session Entry object.

methods.name: TlsSeoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the TLS Session Entry object.
